name: ANATHEMA: The Flowers of Evil
source:
Tractatus and Critique are both living weapons - artificial beings whose purpose is solely to tear apart, destroy and kill the enemies of the New Galactic Order. However, while going to the Mothership's library, Tractatus will meet Maria, a young woman who loves poetry. While talking to her, he will soon discover that his reason to live may not be what he thought it was...

[From [url=https://selenn.itch.io/anathema-the-flowers-of-evil]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
特拉塔图斯与克里蒂克都是活体武器，是专为撕裂、摧毁并杀死新银河秩序敌人而制造的人造生命。然而，在前往母舰图书馆的途中，特拉塔图斯遇见了热爱诗歌的年轻女子玛丽亚。与她交谈后，他很快发现，自己活下去的理由或许并不像原先以为的那样……

[来自[url=https://selenn.itch.io/anathema-the-flowers-of-evil]itch.io[/url]]
